prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for every implant case, but **Dr. David McFadden at The Dental Implant Center** is a strong Dallas option to consider—particularly for complex restorations. The practice says he is board-certified in prosthodontics and oral implantology, and lists its office at **5120 W. Lovers Lane, Dallas**. [Practice details](https://www.dentalimplantcenter.com/our-practice/)

For implant surgery, you may also want an evaluation from a **board-certified oral and maxillofacial surgeon or periodontist**; the surgeon and the dentist who designs and restores the tooth may be different clinicians. Before choosing, ask for a written treatment plan and total cost, who will place and restore the implant, what alternatives are suitable, and what happens if grafting or complications are needed. A second opinion is worthwhile, especially for full-arch treatment.
